reason: The policy authorizes modifying pending order items 'to an available new item of the same product but of different product option' - this prescribes replacement with another item variant, not removal. The candidate action uses modify_pending_order_items with empty new_item_ids, effectively removing three items entirely. This exceeds the authorized scope: the policy does not permit item removal from pending orders (item removal is covered only under 'return delivered order', which requires delivered status). The tool is being used outside its specified purpose of replacing items with alternative variants.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
An order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered'
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.
